newsitem.title: USA: Cause of Fed-Ex Plane Crash Under Investigation.
newsitem.headline: Cause of Fed-Ex Plane Crash Under Investigation.

text.p: Investigators are "working around clock" to determine the cause of the crash of the Federal Express plane Thursday morning, John Golia of the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB), said Friday

The plane, a MD-11 cargo jet, bounced on the runway in Newark, overturned and skidded nearly half a mile down the runway before bursting into flames. All five passengers, including the pilot and co-pilot, escaped through a window. All were treated for minor injuries.
Golia told a news conference the plane was not travelling at excessive speed, "and we just don't know why it made such a hard landing."
"We are searching for a reason, whether it be human or mechanical, on why this plane veered to the right and crashed."
Golia said he would immediately interview the pilot and co-pilot after the press conference.
One runway in Newark International Airport remains closed because of the accident.
